Connect your YouTrack instance.\n\n**How:
Connect your YouTrack instance.

**How to get your permanent token:**
1. Log in to your YouTrack instance
2. Click your avatar -> **Profile** -> **Account Security** (older versions: **Authentication**)
3. Click **New token**, give it the **YouTrack** scope
4. Name it (e.g. "Activepieces") and click **Create**
5. **Copy the token immediately** - it is shown only once
6. Paste it below with your Instance URL

Your **Instance URL** is your browser address, e.g. https://example.youtrack.cloud. A YouTrack Server installed under a path keeps it, e.g. https://example.com/youtrack. The server must use a TLS certificate from a trusted certificate authority.
